description: This file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of GLSurfaceView for OpenGL rendering. It includes lifecycle methods to manage the GLSurfaceView and sets a renderer called CubeRenderer.

classes.name: GLSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating use of GLSurfaceView for OpenGL rendering and managing its lifecycle with activity events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the GLSurfaceView, and assigns a renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume event, resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause event, pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering.
